title: Agents
covers: what it does, step by step

steps.say: Helpers in {product} that do routine work for you - shown first, done when you say so.
Agents do routine work in {product} - such as checking that everything the portal needs is working. Each card is one agent.

steps.chapter: What it does, step by step
steps.say: Under each agent you see its steps in order. A grey tag only looks; an amber tag changes something; a green Trusted tag means that step may run without asking when the agent works on its own.
Press Dry run to see exactly what the agent would do. Nothing is changed - its findings appear on the card, and anything it would change is marked Would do.
When a dry run would change something, Approve appears. Press it and the agent does what the dry run showed, for real.

Tick Runs by itself to let an agent work on its schedule, or when its event happens. The Daily health check looks at what {product} needs - disk space first - every morning, and keeps one warning bar up to date for the owner: a fixed problem clears it, nothing piles up.
History lists every run - when, whether you or the agent started it, and what each step found.
